## Research
- [Causally Sound Memory Invalidation for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents](https://abdulwasea89.github.io/jedak/research/causally-sound-memory-invalidation.html): A framework for detecting and invalidating stale assumptions inside persistent agent memory using causal structure, provenance, and targeted verification.
- [Can Humans Compete with Artificial Intelligence?](https://abdulwasea89.github.io/jedak/research/can-humans-compete-with-artificial-intelligence.html): A research essay on task automation, displacement, complementarity, and how work changes when software agents absorb more of the execution layer.
